Note: If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags with the Tiles
version of Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup, scroll down to the end of this file.


Tiles specific commands
-----------------------

There are several different ways to interact with your environment, both
by typing the command keys, and by using the mouse.

Of notable interest is the clickable tab area to the right of the screen
that allows easy access to e.g. inventory, spells, or common commands.

Depending on your screen resolution, one of more of these panels may be
open at any time, though you can temporarily exchange the inventory view
with another type of tiled panel by clicking on the tab icons.

You can customize the priority of the control panels by modifying the
tile_layout_priority option in init.txt in the settings directory.


Movement
--------

You can move by using the arrow keys, the vi-keys, or the number pad.
(For the latter try both Numlock on and off.)

Numpad:   7 8 9     vi-keys:   y k u
           \|/                  \|/
          4-.-6                h-.-l
           /|\                  /|\
          1 2 3                b j n


To run several steps into the same direction, press Shift along with these
keys.

You can also move by clicking somewhere on the map or minimap with your
mouse. If the square is reachable from your current position and there are
no hostile monsters in sight, you will automatically travel there. If there
are hostile monsters in sight, you will only take a single step at a time.

For automatic exploration, you can either type the 'o' command or you can
click on the corresponding tile in the command panel to the right of your
screen. Like mouseclick travel, these will refuse to work if there are
hostile monsters in sight.


Getting information
-------------------

Doing a right-click with your mouse on any feature, monster or item on the
main map or in the tiled control panels will display the description of
said feature, monster or item on a separate screen.

A simple mouseover will usually display the same description, or as much of
it as can fit, in the message area.

Similarly, letting your mouse rest for a while on a feature, monster or
item will usually display a "tool tip" of applicable commands.


Attacking monsters
------------------

You can attack a monster in melee by moving into it with the movement keys
or by clicking on it with your mouse.

For ranged attacks (including spells and wands), mouse over the monsters
and wait for the tool tip to appear. Alternatively, you can cast spells by
clicking on the spell tiles in the spell panel, or fire ammunition or
evoke wands by clicking on them in the inventory panel.

In the command panel, you'll also find a tile described as "Autofight",
which, if clicked, will attack an adjacent monster in melee, or if there is
no adjacent monster, take one step in the direction of the closest monster.


Item usage
----------

The easiest way to use items is by clicking on them in the inventory panel.
The mouseover tool tip will tell you what a mouseclick will do, and also
the corresponding command key to execute the same action.
As an alternative, you can also use an item by selecting it in the inventory
('i' command) and then pressing the appropriate key in the action prompt.

To pick up items on the ground, you can either click on them one by one in
the floor section of the inventory panel, or you can click on the player
tile and pull up a menu of selectable items instead. In the latter case,
'Enter' will confirm your selection and start pick up.

Dropping items works similarly, either by clicking on single items in the
inventory panel, or by typing the 'd' command and then selecting items
from a menu.


Interacting with the dungeon
----------------------------

Again, doing a mouseover on features (such as staircases or doors) in the
main map will tell you how to interact with them.


Character status
----------------

Doing a right-click on the player tile will display a character overview
screen listing equipment, resistances and stats.

More detailed screens on specific aspects of your characters can be
accessed by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the command panel.


Character appearance
--------------------

You can change your character's appearance with the Doll Editor, accessed with
the '-' command. Use 'm' to switch between modes: Equip, where your appearance
dynamically updates based on the items you equip; Default, a sprite based on
your character’s race and background; and Custom, which allows you to fully
customize each part of your character's look. Use the number keys to switch
between custom doll slots and the arrow keys to modify the different parts of
each custom sprite. Save your changes and selection with 'Ctrl-S'.



If you are experiencing significant slowdown and lags...
--------------------------------------------------------

Crawl renders its graphics using OpenGL and SDL. However, it needs hardware
acceleration to not run slowly. If you are on Windows, make sure to update
your graphics card driver. If you are on Linux, be sure that you are using
DRI.

It has been tested successfully with cards as old as the i865. Unfortunately,
it has been known to be slow on the i810 and there is little to be done in
that case but to run the console version instead or switch to a different
machine.

You can try tweaking a number of options in init.txt in the settings
directory to see whether performance improves:

travel_delay = -1
    This setting suppresses redrawing until travelling is finished or
    interrupted.

tile_update_rate = 1000
    By default, the screen gets redrawn at least every 1000 milliseconds,
    more often if you take actions that change the display. You could try
    cranking up this value, though this may lead to updating taking too long.

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    While running and resting the screen is redrawn every 17 milliseconds.
    If Crawl is slow while running or resting, increase this number.

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    Deactivating the tooltips means there's less stuff to draw every time.

clear_map = false
    Not having to redraw remembered monsters outside your line of sight
    takes some load off the redrawing routines.

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    The larger the map area the more cells there are to redraw each turn.
    If you've got a large display showing way more than the necessary 17x17
    grids of the map, you could try specifying a lower resolution.

图形版专用操作
--------------

你可以用键盘命令或鼠标与周围环境交互。

屏幕右侧可点击的标签页能方便地打开物品栏、法术或常用命令面板。

根据屏幕分辨率，可能同时显示一个或多个面板。点击标签图标，可以暂时把物品栏面板
切换为其他图形面板。

修改 settings 目录中 init.txt 的 tile_layout_priority 选项，可以调整控制面板
的优先顺序。


移动
----

可用方向键、vi 按键或数字小键盘移动。小键盘可尝试开启或关闭 Numlock。

小键盘：  7 8 9     vi 按键： y k u
           \|/                \|/
          4-.-6              h-.-l
           /|\                /|\
          1 2 3              b j n

按住 Shift 再按方向键，可以向同一方向连续行走。

也可以用鼠标点击地图或小地图上的位置。如果该位置可以到达，且视野内没有敌对怪
物，就会自动前往。如果视野内有敌对怪物，则每次只会迈出一步。

按 o 或点击右侧命令面板中的自动探索图标，即可自动探索。与点击地图旅行一样，
视野内有敌对怪物时不能使用。


获取信息
--------

右键点击主地图或控制面板上的地形设施、怪物或物品，会打开其说明界面。

将鼠标移到相应位置，通常也会在消息区显示相同说明，或显示消息区容得下的部分。

将鼠标在地形设施、怪物或物品上停留片刻，通常会出现列出适用命令的提示框。


攻击怪物
--------

使用方向键朝怪物移动，或用鼠标点击怪物，即可进行近战攻击。

进行远程攻击（包括法术和魔杖）时，可把鼠标移到怪物上并等待提示框出现。也可以
点击法术面板的法术图标施法，或点击物品栏面板中的弹药、魔杖进行发射或发动。

命令面板中还有名为 Autofight（自动战斗）的图标。点击它会近战攻击相邻怪物；若
没有相邻怪物，则向最近的怪物迈出一步。


使用物品
--------

最方便的方法是在物品栏面板中点击物品。悬停提示会说明点击的效果，以及执行相同动
作的键盘命令。

也可以按 i 打开物品栏，选择物品，再按操作提示中相应的按键。

拾取地上物品时，可以在物品栏面板的地面区域逐个点击，也可以点击角色图标，打开物
品选择菜单。后者按 Enter 确认选择并开始拾取。

丢弃物品的方式类似：在物品栏面板中点击单件物品，或按 d 后在菜单中选择物品。


与地下城交互
----------

将鼠标移到主地图上的楼梯、门等地形设施，同样会显示如何与其交互。


角色状态
--------

右键点击角色图标，可以打开角色概览，查看装备、抗性和属性数值。

点击命令面板中的相应图标，可以查看角色各方面的详细信息。


角色外观
--------

按 - 打开角色外观编辑器。按 m 切换模式：Equip（装备）会根据穿戴物品动态更新
外观；Default（默认）使用由种族和背景决定的图像；Custom（自定义）允许逐个调
整外观部件。

用数字键切换自定义外观槽位，用方向键修改各个部件。按 Ctrl-S 保存修改和当前选
择。


若游戏明显变慢或卡顿……
--------------------------

Crawl 使用 OpenGL 和 SDL 绘图，需要硬件加速才能流畅运行。Windows 用户应更新
显卡驱动；Linux 用户应确认正在使用 DRI。

游戏曾在 i865 等较老显卡上成功运行；但已知 i810 的运行速度较慢。这种情况下，
通常只能改用字符版或换一台机器。

可尝试调整 settings 目录中的 init.txt，观察下列选项能否改善性能：

travel_delay = -1
    旅行结束或中断之前不重绘画面。

tile_update_rate = 1000
    默认至少每 1000 毫秒重绘一次；执行改变画面的动作时会更频繁。
    可以尝试增大此值，但可能导致画面更新不够及时。

tile_runrest_rate = 17
    连续行走或休息时，每 17 毫秒重绘一次。
    若行走或休息时卡顿，可增大此值。

tile_tooltip_ms = 0
    关闭悬停提示，减少每次需要绘制的内容。

clear_map = false
    不重绘视野外记忆中的怪物，可减少重绘负担。

tile_window_width   = 1024
tile_window_height  = 768
    地图区域越大，每回合需要重绘的格子越多。
    若大屏显示的地图远大于所需的 17x17 格，可以尝试降低分辨率。

Crawl Quick-Start Guide
=======================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell


So, you want to start playing Crawl straight away without bothering with the
manual? Read this, the guide to starting Crawl with a minimum of preparation.

I suggest printing it out and following its instructions while playing your
first few games (you can also press `?` twice while playing for a list of
commands). You should also try the tutorial mode; it only takes a few
minutes.

When you get some more time, you can read `crawl_manual.txt` in the docs/
directory for more detailed information.

INTRODUCTION TO CRAWL
---------------------

Crawl is a large and very random game of subterranean exploration in a fantasy
world of magic and frequent violence. Your quest is to travel into the depths
of the Dungeon (which is different each time you play) and retrieve the Orb of
Zot.

Crawl is an RPG of the `rogue-like` type, one of the descendants of Rogue. Its
graphics are simple but highly informative, designed to be understood at a
glance, and control is exercised largely through one-keystroke commands.

STARTING OUT
------------

After starting the program you will be greeted with a message asking for your
name. Don't spend too much time over this, as your first character will **not**
last very long (sorry, but it's true).

Next you are given menus of species and backgrounds from which to choose.
A mountain dwarf, minotaur or troll Fighter is a good bet. Elves are quite
fragile, humans are pretty average at everything, and the weirder species are
mostly too tricky for beginning players. Finally, you may be given a choice of
weapons. I suggest an axe (axes are fun).

Now you are in the game. The game screen has three parts:

 - the Map takes up the upper left part of the screen. In its very centre is
   the `@` sign (or player doll tile) which represents You. The bright parts of
   the Map are the parts you can see, while places which you have visited
   before but cannot currently see are darkened.
 - the Message box is the large part of the screen below the map. It describes
   events as they happen and asks you questions from time to time.
 - the Stats area (to the right of the Map) contains various indicators of
   your health and abilities.

EXPLORING
---------

Try walking around, using either the numeric keypad (try numlock off and on) or
the Rogue (`hjklyubn`) keys. Pressing `o` will activate auto-explore, which will
move until an enemy is seen, or some other notable event (e.g. finding a set of
stairs) occurs.

If you want to know what a certain character on the screen represents, you can
use the `x` (examine) command to get a short description, and then `v` to get
more information. You use the `O`, `C` commands to open or close doors, and the
`<` (up) and `>` (down) commands to climb staircases.

The Dungeon gets more dangerous (but more interesting!) as you go down. If you
get lost you can access a map of the whole level you are on with the `X`
command, which uses the whole screen.

ITEMS
-----

After walking around for a while, you will no doubt come across some items
lying around (you may come across some monsters as well; for help in dealing
with them skip to the Monsters section). You can pick up items with the `g`
(get) or `,` commands and drop them again with `d` (drop), and the `i`
(inventory) command shows you what you're carrying. While examining your
inventory, press any item's key to see more information about it, and to list
available commands.

There are several different types of items:

 - **Weapons**, represented by the `)` sign. Wield them with the `w` (wield)
   command.
 - **Armour** (`[`). Wear it, or take it off, with the `W` (Wear) command.
   Heavier armours give more protection, but may hamper your ability to dodge,
   cast spells, or fire ranged weapons.
 - **Ammunition** (which has the `(` sign). Throw it with `f` and `F` (fire).
 - **Wands** (`/`), **Scrolls** (`?`) and **Potions** (`!`) can be very
   valuable, but have limited uses (scrolls and potions can only be used once
   each, wands contain only a certain number of charges). Wands are e`V`oked,
   scrolls are `r`ead and potions are `q`uaffed. Unfortunately, you won't at
   first know what a scroll or potion does; it will only be described by its
   physical appearance. But once you have used, for example, a potion of curing,
   you will in the future recognise all potions of curing.
 - **Rings** (`=`) and **Amulets** (`"`) provide various mostly-helpful effects.

================

Copyright 1999 Linley Henzell

建议把它打印出来，在最初几局游戏中边玩边参考。游戏中连续按两次 `?`，
也能查看命令列表。还应试试教程模式，只需几分钟。

CRAWL 简介
------------

Crawl 是一款规模庞大、随机性很强的地下探索游戏。这个奇幻世界充满魔法，
也时常充斥暴力。你的任务是深入每局都不相同的地下城，取回佐特宝珠。

Crawl 是 `rogue-like` 类型的角色扮演游戏，是 Rogue 的后继者之一。
画面虽然简单，却信息丰富，力求一目了然；操作大多只需按一个键。

开始游戏
----------

启动程序后，会先询问你的名字。不必花太多时间，因为你的第一个角色
**不会**活得很久（抱歉，但这是事实）。

接下来从菜单选择种族和背景。山地矮人、牛头人或巨魔战士都不错。
精灵比较脆弱，人类各方面都很平均，更奇异的种族则大多不适合新手。
最后，可能还需要选择武器。推荐斧头，因为斧头很好玩。

现在你进入游戏了。游戏画面分为三个部分：

 - 地图位于屏幕左上方。正中央的 `@`（或角色图标）代表你。
   明亮部分是当前能看到的区域；曾去过、现在看不到的地方则会变暗。
 - 消息区位于地图下方，占据较大空间。它会叙述事件，并不时询问你。
 - 状态区位于地图右侧，显示生命、能力等各种指标。

探索
------

试着用数字键盘（可尝试开关 Numlock），或 Rogue 的 `hjklyubn` 键移动。
按 `o` 会启动自动探索，持续移动，直到看见敌人或发生其他值得注意的事件，
例如发现楼梯。

想知道屏幕上某个字符代表什么，可以按 `x` 查看简述，再按 `v` 阅读详情。
用 `O`、`C` 开门或关门，用 `<` 上楼、`>` 下楼。

地下城越深，越危险，也越有趣！迷路时可按 `X` 打开占满屏幕的楼层地图。

物品
------

走一会儿，你一定会发现地上的物品，也可能遇见怪物；应对怪物的方法见后文。
用 `g` 或 `,` 拾取，用 `d` 丢弃，用 `i` 查看携带物品。
在物品栏中按物品对应的键，可以查看详情和可用操作。

物品主要分为以下几类：

 - **武器**以 `)` 表示。按 `w` 持用。
 - **防具**以 `[` 表示。按 `W` 穿上或脱下。
   越重的防具通常防护越好，但可能妨碍闪避、施法或远程武器射击。
 - **弹药**以 `(` 表示。用 `f` 和 `F` 投射。
 - **魔杖**（`/`）、**卷轴**（`?`）和**药水**（`!`）可能非常有价值，
   但使用次数有限：卷轴和药水各只能使用一次，魔杖则只有一定次数的充能。
   按 `V` 唤发魔杖，按 `r` 阅读卷轴，按 `q` 喝药水。
   最初你不知道卷轴或药水的效果，只能看到外观描述。
   例如使用过一瓶治疗药水后，以后就能认出所有治疗药水。
 - **戒指**（`=`）和**护身符**（`"`）提供各种效果，大多有益。
   用 `P` 戴上，用 `R` 摘下。
 - **金币**（`$`）可以在商店购物。

还有一些其他物品类型，你会在游戏中逐渐发现。

怪物
------

你也会遇见怪物，大多用字母表示。朝怪物所在方格移动，就会攻击它。
按 Tab 会自动靠近并攻击附近怪物。

受伤时，你会损失生命值，显示在状态列表上方附近。
生命值会随时间自然恢复；生命耗尽，你就会死亡。

要活下去，你需要掌握一些基本战术：

 - 战斗之间要休息。`s`、`.`、Delete 或数字键盘 5 可休息一回合；
   按 `5` 或 Shift 加数字键盘 5 可长时间休息，完全恢复后会停止。
 - 尽量不要同时与多只怪物作战。退入走廊，让它们只能逐一与你交战。
 - 死后，卷轴和药水等消耗品就帮不上忙了。多数消耗品在艰难战斗开始时
   使用，比濒死时才用更有效。可以在安全处“浪费”同一叠中的一个来提前鉴定。
 - 与怪物近战前，记得先用投射物攻击。
 - 学会在无法应付时逃跑，这一点很重要！跳过危险楼层往往是明智之举，
   但也别过分依赖这种做法。

死亡
------

过不了多久，你大概就会死去。

Crawl 中的死亡是永久的，不能重新载入存档，从原处再来。
`S` 保存命令只是为了让你中途离开，以后继续同一局游戏。
如果连帮角色逃生都不想费心了，可以用 `Ctrl-Q` 放弃角色。

快速入门到此结束。它应该能帮你度过最初几局，但 Crawl 极其复杂，
有人甚至觉得复杂过头，无法用这么短的文档说清楚。
准备开始尝试魔法、技能和信仰时，请翻阅手册。

祝你冒险愉快！

changes.english:
A cyclops shepherd, he is very protective of his charges, whom he watches with
an undying fervor through his single massive eye. Nevertheless, he won't
hesitate to use them as projectiles in a pinch; after all, the best defence is
a good offence.

这个独眼巨人牧羊人，非常爱惜自己的牲畜，
他用那只透露着永恒热情的巨大的眼睛注视着它们。
尽管如此，在紧要关头，他还是会毫不犹豫地将它们用作弹丸；
毕竟，最好的防守就是好的进攻。

changes.english:
A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though
perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still
they seem somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past.
The memory and the memorialist fight in concert, each able to fire past the
other.
changes.before: 一个由无实体记忆构成的人形造物，漂浮在空中。虽然外形或许有些改变，且少有可辨特征，仍依稀像一位来自遥远记忆的战士。记忆与追忆者并肩作战，双方都能让飞射物穿过彼此。

changes.english:

armour. Although stationary, its branches are possessed with a will of their
own. They move to allow magic and missiles fired by those friendly to this
plant to pass through unaffected.

not very dense, permitting both magic and missiles to pass through unaffected.

changes.english:
Many poltergeists are fiercely territorial over the domains they choose to
haunt, but these have extended that protection even to the people who share
their domain with them. Some say they must be the lingering souls of those who
guarded the Vaults in life; others suggest the Ironbound Order simply recruited
them in common cause. Whichever is true, their very presence shelters other
creatures from missiles, causing sling and spell alike to veer off-course at the
last moment.

<h>Known items menu</h>

<h>Navigation and selecting items</h>
Use the usual navigation keys (<w>arrow</w> keys, <w>pgdn</w>/<w>pgup</w>, <w>home</w>, <w>end</w>) to select
items, and <w>Space</w>/<w>.</w> to toggle the autopickup mode for the selected item type.
Pressing an item type's letter key will also toggle its autopickup state.

<h>Selecting item types</h>
Item types displayed in grey use the default autopickup options set in your
configuration file. (Items that are useless to your character are displayed
in <darkgrey>dark grey</darkgrey>.) Selecting a type of item overrides those options
(indicated by <w>white</w> text), and toggles the item between the states:
 <w>+</w>  Items of this type will be picked up automatically.
 <w>-</w>  Items of this type will not be picked up automatically.
Autopickup can also be toggled for all unknown items of a given category.

<h>Category shortcuts</h>
You can quickly select all item types in a given category by pressing:
<w>!</w>   potions      <w>?</w>   scrolls      <w>(</w>   ammunition        <w>"</w>   amulets
<w>=</w>   rings        <w>/</w>   wands        <w>|</w>   magical staves
Global selects:  <w>*</w>   invert all   <w>^</w>   reset all to default

<h>Viewing unknown and known items</h>
<w>\</w> and <w>-</w> toggle between the known and unknown items menus. Note
that none of the above features are available from the unknown items menu.

<h>Restoring autopickup defaults</h>
Pressing <w>Ctrl-D</w> followed by an item letter or a category shortcut
cancels the override and restores the selected item or items to their default
settings.

<h>Regular expressions</h>
You can press <w>Ctrl-F</w> to enter a word (or a regular expression).
All matching items will be selected.
